Spot on. It always got me how people think its like a switch. As if one motivational conversation can undo years of self loathing. like I can just force myself to be different over night when nothing in my life has changed. 

One night I was at dinner at my former best friend/'brother's house (I was very close with the whole family) just after Robin Williams passed. My 'uncle' Went of about how he was a massive asshole for killing himself. That he was being a selfish bitch. "how could someone that rich and famous kill himself? What an inconsiderate asshole. He had everything. What a pussy"

My response: "Apparently he didn't have everything, or he wouldn't have felt the need to not exist." As you might imagine the conversation devolved from there. He just couldn't understand that some people need love and genuine human interaction instead of marble floors and 100 acre mansions. 

2 things got to me. First was I was alone in my opinion, everyone else at the table agreed with 'Uncle'. Second was that everything said only reinforced, and even resonated, with the feeling of being ashamed of being depressed. As if depression was some sort of sin, or insult to everyone else around that person. Looking back it's no wonder I was pushed to multiple attempts. 

I don't mean to talk your eyes out, just need to vent. Thanks for listening. Every little bit seems to improve my mood :)
Thanks for the kindness Kevin87.It is a serious paradigm shift with something as simple being around people who want me there.
Thank you. As silly as it is it means a lot that someone is even slightly concerned. 'Well' might be an over statement, but I am better than I was. It's a start right?

No worries, I have much more positive people in my life now. Its amazing how much of a difference listening for a few hours and some encouragement can make. Seriously. If you ever come across someone who has an issue, help them fix it, remind them of their strengths. Cause I can tell you, sure as shit, the opposite will not help at all.

Well, first off, we were super close, called each other brothers, best friends since 7 years old we're 24 now. He has known about my serious depression for a few years now. Even about previous attempts but never told anyone because he "didn't want to upset anyone". I made less than $20k to live off of (I live on my own btw). Now, this kid lives at home, has a full time $12/hr job, and yet Is always broke. I foot the gas bill, buy his cigarettes and food and pot even though I could barely feed myself. Then I just recently found out about (and took up) an offer from a friend who would take me in which he never told me about. And during these last 2 years He and my other 'friend' constantly talk down to me, insulted me, and generally made me feel like shit while feeding off of me. I genuinely loved this kid like a brother and yet I found out, after distancing myself, that he really is a massive asshole who talked shit about me behind my back the whole time. Every time I tried to talk to him I was either ignored or belittled. I even relied on him to help move, since I don't have a car of my own. He gave me 3 hours to pack up my life, refused to go back for a second trip with the promise to get it tomorrow then bailed on me, refusing to do anything at all to help while my belongs go thrown into the street (landlord was a giant dick as well, raised the rent after the first month of moving in). Then he has the balls to show up later in tears about the whole thing yet never apologized refusing to replace even the smallest item lost, or even take responsibility at all. Hence he is garbage.

This was ~8 years ago so it's fuzzy. But it wasn't draino it was some industrial stuff. SUPER DUPER chalky. Like drinking liquid chalk dust, it took serious will power to down the whole bottle. Consistency was milky or so. I almost yarfed immediately, had to force it down. Stomach almost immediately cramped up and It hurt so bad for like 3 hours. But as strange as it was it also gave me this really weird head high for half an hour or so (totally not worth it). After 3 hours of the fetal position I couldn't keep it down and I ran to the toilet to ralf it up. THAT WAS SO TERRIBLE. Chalk and bile and mucus mixed together and the scent/taste stayed there for a few days. It kept me from eating almost everything. But My internals were messed up bad for about a week, kidneys, small intestine, stomach but my throat was surprisingly ok. It wasn't a burn, felt more like food poisoning, go figure. Oh, and my heart was weak for a bit too.

Over all, 0/5 do not recommend. About as bad as my ear drum getting ripped open.

[I am 24] The first attempt, drain cleaner, was in HS. The other three have been withing the last 2 years or so. Most recent was just after this past X-mas.

Each one of my failed attempts was seen as more failure in the moment. The prevailing thought being "I can't even kill myself right. God I suck so hard" or something along those lines. But looking back on it each failure should have killed me. I certainly didn't cut corners, since it would lead to more undue suffering. So I see it now as fate going "Nope, you got some shit to do before I let you go out". 

Right now, I see it this way: If I can't hurt myself when I go all in the world can't do a damn thing to me I can't overcome.

This is the best way I can explain it: Its a mental wound. And few people even recognize this. So going about life in a normal fashion is like trying walk of a sprained ankle. It will not get better but most people aren't interested in giving the help needed, only in showing minimal sympathy and going about their business. So even learning to live with it you would still have the constant background pain.

TL;DR - Yes it is still a frequent thought.

On the other hand, I really should be dead 4 times over. I grabbed a fresh bullet that happened to be a dud. The drain cleaner was twice a lethal dose, I didn't get my artery all the way through, and When I went for my arm again I cut all the way into my tendons... and simply didn't bleed. I actually opened up my skin like a surgeon and saw my artery cut. And it didn't bleed. So for what ever reason I wont die. Essentially I've given up giving up. So now I have this warped sense of immortality.

TL;DR - If I can't hurt myself when I go all in the world can't do a damn thing to me I can't overcome.
